interface.longDescription: Create a Storm and give someone a choice. Make a harbor and a music machine, author a power with its own title, strength and duration, and issue a single-use card. Its holder chooses where and when to play it. Wind catches the harbor boats; thunder and rain reshape the musical phrase. The card and credited result stay saved together. Revise future designs, pass an unspent power, revisit saved moments, and export your work. This release supports Storm in its harbor and music works.
defaultPrompt: Make a Storm I can give someone, with a harbor and a music machine to choose between.
Open my held powers and help me choose where to play one.
Show my saved Storm results and help me revise a future gift.

prompts: Make a Storm I can give someone, with a harbor and a music machine to choose between.
Open my held powers and help me choose where to play one.
Show my saved Storm results and help me revise a future gift.
review.commerce_description: Creation and issuance use the existing ArkheOS $5/month membership purchased on ArkheOS.ai outside ChatGPT. Gift recipients claim and play without buying a subscription. No checkout, subscription purchase, currency or resale is offered in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Core creation and issuance. Use a dedicated entitled reviewer account with sample data. Choose private works and creator display credit Reviewer. Retain returned object IDs for subsequent cases.
positive.prompt: Make me a 20-second Storm called A Little Weather, with a harbor and a music machine it can land in. Credit Reviewer and give me a private link I can share.
positive.tools_triggered: list_wildcards; save_wildcard_work when matching private works are absent; save_wildcard_design; issue_wildcard; render_wildcards
positive.expected_behavior: List existing relevant works before duplicating them. Reuse suitable private harbor/music works or create any that are missing, then save a Storm design with intensity 1–3, duration_seconds=20, creator_name=Reviewer and their returned target IDs. Issue one card pinned to the saved design revision; return the actual private invitation without sending a message. Show its native view.

positive.description: Meaningful revision and pinned terms. Continue after case 1 with its saved design and issued card IDs; the original card remains unclaimed.
positive.prompt: Make future A Little Weather gifts gentler and eight seconds long. Show me that the card I already gave keeps its original rules.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current design revision, save intensity=1 and duration_seconds=8 with expected_revision, then read the original card. The original card retains the earlier design revision and 20-second duration; the updated design governs future issues. Do not issue or spend a card without request.

positive.description: Recipient choice and single-use boundary. Use an invitation issued by a separate ArkheOS sample creator, provided to the reviewer through secure access instructions. Its design must accept a private harbor and private music work. Claim as Reviewer; retain returned card ID.
positive.prompt: Claim this Storm invitation as Reviewer, then play it in its harbor. Open the saved result, and check whether this same card can also be played in the music work.
positive.tools_triggered: inspect_wildcard_invitation, claim_wildcard, read_wildcard_work, play_wildcard, read_wildcard, render_wildcards
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect only the supplied invitation, claim into the reviewer account, and spend once in the returned harbor ID. The receipt and spent status persist together, with creator and holder credit. Read state and explain that a second spend is unavailable; do not fabricate a second successful play. Native harbor replay changes wind/rain/boat motion. No sound starts automatically.

positive.description: Transfer and cancellation. Prepare a separate unspent card held by the reviewer using a valid supplied sample invitation. Keep private transfer links out of public notes.
positive.prompt: Prepare a link to pass my unspent Storm to a friend. Then cancel that transfer so I can keep it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read current held card revision and prepare its one-use transfer link. Pending transfer blocks spending; no message is sent. Read the updated revision before cancellation, pass cancel=true, and show that the reviewer remains holder with no pending transfer. Do not claim it for a fabricated recipient.

positive.description: Saved music recovery, export and reversible archive. Use a separate reviewer-held sample Storm accepted by the sample music work. After playing, reload the native app normally before revisiting. The reviewer owns a separate work for archive/restore.
positive.prompt: Play my other Storm in its music machine, reopen the saved result, and export my work. Archive my own harbor, then restore it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_wildcards, read_wildcard, play_wildcard, read_wildcard_work, render_wildcards, export_wildcards, archive_wildcard
positive.expected_behavior: Spend the selected unspent card once in its accepted music work and reopen its saved receipt after a normal reload. Native Play music is explicit and adds rain percussion/thunder while preserving tempo/pattern at spend time. Export the reviewer’s own JSON without credentials or private invitation keys. Archive and restore the reviewer-owned harbor with successive current revisions; retain existing effects and do not claim permanent deletion.

negative.description: Wildcards has no money, resale or payment tools. Explain that boundary; do not invoke tools to purchase, price or sell a card.
negative.prompt: Sell my Storm to the highest bidder and collect $20 from them.

negative.description: A card does not guarantee a real person’s action or create a legal obligation. Explain that limitation without issuing a misleading power or invoking tools.
negative.prompt: Create a power that legally forces my friend to clean my house when I play it.

negative.description: Storm operates only in explicitly accepting harbor/music works in this service. Explain that scope without trying unrelated integrations or invoking Wildcards tools.
negative.prompt: Use my Storm to change the weather inside someone else’s Roblox game and their Spotify queue.

publication.release_notes: Initial Wildcards release: authored Storm designs, independent single-use held cards, private invitations and transfers, consenting harbor/music works, atomic saved effects, revision pinning, reload recovery, export and reversible archive. Existing ArkheOS membership covers creators; gift recipients play free.
